sources.title: Civimatica Models | AI built on measured streets
sources.snippet: Ready-to-use AI models for streets, kerbs, corridors and movement, trained on street data we measure ourselves. Plug in; you do not build or train the stack.

sources.title: Civimatica | Physical AI for the real city
sources.snippet: Civimatica builds AI models for urban space and the sensing devices they run on, and gives companies the data, ground truth and real-street test environment to train and validate their own.
